content: Humility is the father of all virtue; the great mountain does not boast of its height, yet the entire valley honors it.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: The person who is constantly shouting about their achievements, credentials, and greatness resembles an insecure child. The towering snow-capped peak says nothing; its silent, grounded presence commands the awe of all who gaze upon it. Let your character speak for itself.
practicalInsight: Refuse to brag or seek validation today. Rest in the quiet, unshakeable dignity of the mountain.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you feel the urge to advertise your achievements, instead of resting in quiet, authentic capability?
